in_hebrew.name: רודג
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'rod' (רוד) meaning 'to see', this name could mean 'seeing a rod' or 'a seer with a rod'. The name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Ροδγος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'ροδος' (rhodos) meaning 'a rod', this name could mean 'rod-bearer' or 'rod-carrier'. The name is not found in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Rodgus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'roddus' derived from 'roddus' meaning 'rod'. The name is not found in the Bible.
